parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865 (HDAC6) where canonical_smiles exists and the document has a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs (via assays.doc_id), compound_records (via activities.record_id), and compound_structures (INNER JOIN). Coalesce docs.doi and docs.pubmed_id into pubmed_id_or_doi preferring DOI. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
